mentions.name: rtk
mentions.description: A CLI wrapper/filter that makes LLM agent interactions more signal-to-noise efficient by silencing or summarizing redundant command output (like repeated ls -al or cat calls), so coding agents only receive the necessary delta. It reduces token waste and context pollution, keeping sessions useful for longer before the agent loses the plot.
mentions.problem: Coding agents burn tokens on info they already have (the "Token Tax") and fill the context window with redundant noise from repeated orientation commands like ls -al and cat.
mentions.source_excerpt: rtk acts as a CLI wrapper/filter to make LLM interactions more signal-to-noise efficient. It silences or summarizes redundant outputs so the agent only receives the necessary "delta."
